about.summary: Senior Laravel engineer who builds scalable web systems — SaaS platforms, APIs, desktop and mobile applications — with a focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production reliability.
about.extended:
I am a Senior Software Engineer and Laravel Developer with 5+ years of professional experience designing and developing scalable web applications, SaaS platforms, REST APIs, and enterprise systems.

I work across diverse business domains depending on product needs — not limited to one industry. Before my current role, I spent several years as an independent developer delivering private projects in logistics, retail, health, and transport.

Throughout my career, I have contributed to and led development across the full software lifecycle — from requirements analysis and system architecture to implementation, integration, debugging, optimization, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

I focus on building clean, maintainable, secure, and scalable systems rather than simply delivering functionality.

resume.profile: Senior Laravel Engineer with 5+ years of experience building SaaS platforms, REST APIs, enterprise systems, desktop and mobile applications. Experienced in employment and independent client projects across multiple industries. Currently based in Riyadh.
